[BRD] AIX Phase 2 ​
Reinaldo Gani
Modified March 6
Overview​
In Phase 1 of AIX development, we are working with dtcPay to support several functions needed to launch stablecoins backed debit cards in the Philippines​
​
Phase 1 has several limitations around compliance and risk management due to our reliance on dtcPay's VASP license, including:​
1.
Revenue from AUM treasury management​
2.
Future features (e.g., yield-bearing, fiat payout, etc) development requires dtcPay's approval before we can proceed​
3.
Crypto withdrawal​
4.
Authentication controls for high-risk transactions (crypto deposits/withdrawals)​
5.
KYT and Travel Rule compliance policy set-up and implementation​
6.
Policy of spending and balance limits​
​
In Phase 2, AIX will transition to a license-led operating model to reduce dependency on individual partners and gain greater control over product scope, limits, and supported activities. Holding our own VASP license will allow AIX to independently manage regulatory requirements across jurisdictions, rather than inheriting constraints from upstream providers.​
​
In parallel, AIX will adopt a modular infrastructure strategy. To achieve broader card coverage, we will onboard multiple BIN issuers to tackle multiple jurisdictions, as dtcPay’s issuing capabilities are limited in several target countries. AIX will also establish our own custody and compliance stack by partnering with institutional crypto custody providers such as Cobo or Utila, and integrating independent KYT and Travel Rule vendors.​
Market Coverage​
TBD - Markets will be organized into regional clusters, with priority countries identified within each region.​
​
Market Selection Criteria​
Priority markets are determined through a three-matrix framework:​
1.
Market Attractiveness Indicators:​
◦
Economic factors: High inflation, strict FX controls, elevated digital service taxes​
◦
User base: Significant freelance/remittance populations, high crypto on-ramp costs​
◦
Regulatory environment: Crypto payment restrictions, legal gambling​
◦
Activity levels: Strong play-to-earn and airdrop engagement​
2.
Competitive Landscape: We benchmark against market leaders' geographic footprints (RedotPay and Binance top 20 markets)​
